relationships.subject: ropivacaine
relationships.evidence_quote: All MAPK-DUSPs (MKP) were transcriptionally upregulated until 6 h of ropivacaine exposure, with the exception of DUSP9, which was rapidly downregulated to approximately 10% of the basal expression, remaining low up to 6 h.

relationships.subject: ropivacaine
relationships.evidence_quote: However, in contrast to its isoform PHLPP2, PHLPP1 became upregulated after 2 h, reaching a maximum of approximately 300% at 4–6 h.

relationships.subject: ropivacaine
relationships.evidence_quote: Increases in these analytes were time-dependent, starting with a significant upregulation of COX-2 at 1 h and an increase in its product PGE2 after 4 h, until 24 h of ropivacaine exposure.

key_findings: Ropivacaine switched off DUSP9 and induced PHLPP1 in HUVECs and trophoblasts in a cell-type-specific manner
Extravillous trophoblasts released IL-6, IL-8, TNFa, COX-2 and PGE2 in response to ropivacaine
